items.title: Algorithmic Impact Reveals the Hidden Social Choice Structure of Alignment
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.24046v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: When an AI algorithm makes decisions that affect more than one person, aligning it becomes a problem of social choice: how should people's divergent preferences about system behavior be reconciled and aggregated into a single coherent model? The standard approach to aligning frontier AI models$\unicode{x2013}$reinforcement learning from human feedback$\unicode{x2013}$largely sidesteps this question and has poor social choice guarantees. However, it remains unclear what alternative should replace it. We show that, by focusing directly on an algorithm's welfare consequences, the alignment problem can be reformulated as linear optimization over a convex impact space, which makes it amenable to the standard toolkit of welfare economics and mechanism design. items.reason_zh: 揭示AI对齐背后的社会选择结构，用算法影响分析偏好聚合，对AI伦理与治理有深远意义。
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了AI算法在影响多人决策时的对齐问题，将其视为社会选择问题。作者提出使用算法影响（algorithmic impact）来揭示对齐过程中隐藏的社会选择结构，分析如何将不同用户的偏好聚合为单一模型。通过形式化框架，文章论证了现有对齐方法（如RLHF）在偏好聚合上的局限性，并提出了改进方向。研究为AI对齐的公平性和透明度提供了理论支撑。
items.title_zh: 算法影响揭示对齐的隐藏社会选择结构

items.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.23691v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature. Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prior literature on five problems: a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets, new exact 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11, new records for the discretized Kakeya needle and sign uncertainty problems, and a substantially improved lower bound for Erd\H{o}s's minimum-overlap problem. items.title: Minima-KV: Retention-Preserving KV Cache Compression with Mixed-Format Paged Attention
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.23834v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is a primary capacity and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context LLM serving. We present Minima-KV, a retention-preserving hierarchy for mixed-format paged attention. Recent and protected Anchor pages remain in FP8, while older non-anchor pages move to packed TQ3; every live-request page remains addressable. Format-specific kernels compute partial attention states and combine them through a globally normalized online-softmax merge, enabling direct heterogeneous decode without a cache-sized dense shadow. Across separate, configuration-bound Qwen3.6-27B profiles on a single 96-GB NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, deployment accounting reports 18.3 KiB of attention KV per live token, corresponding to 3.50x compression relative to BF16 and 1.75x relative to FP8. items.reason_zh: 提出混合格式分页注意力的KV缓存压缩方法，显著提升长上下文服务效率。
items.summary_zh: Minima-KV提出了一种保留性的KV缓存压缩层次结构，采用混合格式分页注意力。在长上下文LLM服务中，KV缓存是主要的容量和带宽瓶颈。该方法将近期和受保护的Anchor页面保留在FP8格式，而较旧的非Anchor页面则转换为打包的TQ3格式，同时保持每个活动请求页面的可寻址性。这种格式特定的键管理策略在保持缓存保留性的同时，有效减少了内存占用和带宽需求。
items.title_zh: Minima-KV：混合格式分页注意力的保留性KV缓存压缩

items.title: Serving Masked Diffusion LLMs: Characterization and Design Principles from Real Hardware
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.23807v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can in principle generate text faster than autoregressive (AR) models, since they denoise many tokens at once. Recent systems have begun building serving infrastructure for dLLMs, but none first measure how these models behave under real, concurrent serving load. Serving systems built without this grounding risk carrying over assumptions from AR serving that may not hold for dLLMs. We characterize dLLM serving to close this gap, using LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a D2F (Discrete Diffusion Forcing) LoRA adapter on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, evaluated on GSM8K and HumanEval. We report three findings. First, request difficulty, the number of denoising steps a request needs, is discrete rather than continuous: requests fall into 11 fixed step-count levels (178 + 29k), and no signal we test predicts the level before generation starts (best R2 = 0.150). items.reason_zh: 首次从真实硬件测量掩码扩散LLM的并发服务行为，为系统设计提供实证基础。
items.summary_zh: 该研究对掩码扩散语言模型（dLLMs）在真实并发服务负载下的行为进行了表征，并提出了设计原则。尽管dLLMs理论上可以比自回归模型更快地生成文本，但现有服务系统缺乏对其实时行为的测量。该研究通过硬件实验，揭示了dLLMs在并发服务中的性能特征，为构建高效的dLLM服务基础设施提供了关键见解和设计指导。
items.title_zh: 服务掩码扩散LLM：来自真实硬件的表征与设计原则

items.title: 工业Agent不是“套壳”大模型！西门子百年经验灌进工业AI
items.raw_text: 西门子Xcelerator与普通软件货架最本质的区别。货架解决的是「把产品卖出去」，西门子Xcelerator要解决的是「让产品在真实工业场景中持续生长」。
items.reason_zh: 西门子将百年工业经验注入工业AI，揭示工业Agent非套壳，深度剖析真实场景落地。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨西门子Xcelerator与普通软件货架的本质区别，强调工业Agent不是简单套壳大模型，而是要让产品在真实工业场景中持续生长。西门子凭借百年工业经验，将领域知识融入AI系统，解决实际痛点。文章深入分析了工业AI的挑战与机遇，为从业者提供了宝贵见解。
items.title_zh: 工业Agent不是“套壳”大模型！西门子百年经验灌进工业AI

items.title: Token效率鄙视链被打脸：实测证明，Rust才是AI编程时代的隐藏赢家
items.raw_text: 本文基于Danluu最新博客文章的实测数据，梳理了「AI编程语言效率鄙视链」话题的来龙去脉，重点分析了Rust在真实工程任务下的AI编程表现。数据显示，此前流传的「动态语言天生省Token」结论建立在极小规模题目上，一旦换成Zstd解码器、Pandoc这类真实工程任务，结论迅速站不住脚；而一份曾被用来证明「Rust的所有权模型拖累AI编程效率」的评测，其实源于测试脚本本身的Bug。文章同时讨论了内存安全的隐藏成本、语言流行度与Agent表现的相关性，为技术团队在AI辅助编程语言选型上提供更审慎的参考。
items.reason_zh: 基于实测数据推翻“动态语言省Token”的流行观点，揭示Rust在AI编程中的优势，数据详实，有说服力。
items.summary_zh: 本文基于Danluu的博客实测数据，分析了AI编程语言效率的讨论。此前认为动态语言更省Token，但真实工程任务（如Zstd解码器、Pandoc）中结论相反。Rust在AI编程中表现优异，而一份证明Rust所有权模型拖累效率的评测源于测试脚本Bug。文章还讨论了内存安全的隐藏成本、语言流行度与Agent表现的相关性，为技术团队选型提供参考。
items.title_zh: Token效率鄙视链被打脸：实测证明，Rust才是AI编程时代的隐藏赢家

items.title: Stop Giving Your AI Agent a Search Box and Start Giving It Typed Tools, Hard Bounds, and a Gate It Cannot Talk Past
items.raw_text:
What happens when you stop feeding a model context and let it go find its own, walking a knowledge graph within strict limits, and what four models and one wrong prediction revealed about whether that is worth doing.

The post Stop Giving Your AI Agent a Search Box and Start Giving It Typed Tools, Hard Bounds, and a Gate It Cannot Talk Past appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.reason_zh: 探讨给AI代理提供类型化工具和硬边界，而非搜索框，实验揭示有效方法。

items.title: 像素级对标？智谱、Kimi 底层参数「撞衫」背后，藏着线性注意力的黄金窗口
items.raw_text: 国产大模型内卷到算子底层。
items.reason_zh: 智谱和Kimi底层参数相似，揭示线性注意力机制的优势，对理解模型架构有启发。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了智谱和Kimi两个AI模型在底层参数上的相似性，指出它们可能都采用了线性注意力机制。这种机制在处理长序列时具有计算效率优势，成为当前模型设计的黄金窗口。文章通过对比分析，揭示了线性注意力在模型性能上的潜力，并讨论了其背后的技术细节和行业影响。对于关注AI模型架构的读者，提供了有价值的洞察。
